newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: CANTV rate rise still under study.
newsitem.headline: CANTV rate rise still under study.

text.p: A long-awaited quarterly rate rise for Venezuela's national telephone company CANTV is still being studied and there is no date for a decision to be reached, Transport and Communications Minister Moises Orozco said Thursday.
"We are still studying the (rate) scheme," Orozco told reporters in Congress.

CANTV has proposed a 1.98 percent rate rise for the third quarter of the year. Orozco has frequently criticized the GTE Corp run company for failing to provide a breakdown of its costs structure to back up the rate rise.
